ranked.headline: Explicit noise and measurement models refine RNA-seq cell-type and spatial inference
ranked.summary: Single-cell, nucleus and spatial RNA-seq datasets now demand explicit handling of noise, transcript assignment and cross-platform shifts.

ranked.headline: Deep learning predicts molecular interactions, binding effects and designed ligands
ranked.summary: Recent work extends sequence, graph and language-model architectures to interaction, binding-affinity and molecular design tasks.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking docking and structure models for protein and PROTAC complexes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications benchmark docking and AlphaFold 3 models for antibody, ebolavirus and PROTAC complexes against physics-based tools.

ranked.headline: Computational tools for marker detection, GRN inference, and expression benchmarking
ranked.summary: Recent work tests new scoring, forecasting, and information-theoretic methods on transcriptomic data against simple baselines.

ranked.headline: Deep learning links genomic variants and chromatin accessibility to gene regulation
ranked.summary: Sequence-based and single-cell models now map variants and chromatin accessibility to regulatory and expression readouts across several genomic modalities.

ranked.headline: Gapless and long-read human genome references with population-scale multiomic data
ranked.summary: Gapless T2T assemblies and long-read benchmarks now define reference-grade truth sets for human variant calling and population imputation.

ranked.headline: Graph and transport models infer regulatory and cell-state structure from transcriptomes
ranked.summary: Single-cell and spatial transcriptomics now pair graph neural networks, optimal transport, and semantic gene embeddings to infer regulatory structure.

ranked.headline: Computational prediction scales from single proteins to human proteome-wide screens
ranked.summary: Proteome-scale predictions of human interactions and disordered regions now appear alongside feature-driven classifiers benchmarked against annotations.

ranked.headline: Open computational tools for methylation, single-cell, CLIP and k-mer data analysis
ranked.summary: Recent releases target storage, reproducibility and benchmarking bottlenecks in methylation, single-cell and CLIP-based regulatory data analysis.

ranked.headline: Genomic resources shift toward marker, population and epigenetic inference in crops and…
ranked.summary: Population-scale pear, spruce and Vitis datasets now test domestication, introgression and inherited methylation directly rather than stopping at assembly.

ranked.headline: Machine learning links bacterial genotypes to antimicrobial resistance phenotypes
ranked.summary: Random-forest and mixture-of-experts models now address carbapenemase detection and resistance evolution from routine and genomic data.

ranked.headline: Computational Prediction of Immune Protein Recognition and Benchmarking
ranked.summary: Predictors for antibody pairing, MHC presentation, and T-cell epitope immunogenicity are being tested against curated or measured experimental data.

ranked.headline: GPU and SIMD acceleration of sequence alignment and metagenomic read simulation
ranked.summary: Recent tools pair GPU and SIMD acceleration with scriptable or composable interfaces for large sequence and metagenomic datasets.

ranked.headline: Reduced and learned representations recover conformational dynamics from MD and AFM data
ranked.summary: Recent MD and AFM studies pair dimensionality reduction, variational autoencoders, Markov state models, and guided diffusion with conformational analysis of…

ranked.headline: Protein language embeddings aligned with structure, binding-site and text modalities
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published model pair pretrained protein language model embeddings with structural and other complementary modalities.

ranked.headline: Structure-based and learned methods predict small-molecule and RNA binding recognition
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers extend structure-based docking and learned models to RNA targets, pocket identification, and CNS penetration prediction.

ranked.headline: Kinetic and noise-aware models infer single-cell gene expression dynamics
ranked.summary: Paired single-cell measurements and minute-scale transcriptomics now constrain kinetic models of stochastic expression and cellular dynamics.

ranked.headline: MD simulations map allosteric rewiring and lipid scrambling in viral and membrane proteins
ranked.summary: Enhanced-sampling and coarse-grained MD now resolve variant-specific allosteric networks and refined conformational sampling of large protein assemblies.

ranked.headline: Computational models prioritize targets in neuroblastoma, metastasis and kinase signaling
ranked.summary: Autonomous AI and mechanistic models are now being tested against public datasets and null benchmarks to rank candidate biological targets.

ranked.headline: Computational tools for MS and imaging omics: benchmarking, metadata, and annotation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints add benchmarked, provenance-aware, and validated computational tooling to omics analysis pipelines.

ranked.headline: Learned tokenization and compression reshape biological sequence and structure models
ranked.summary: Three November 2025 preprints revisit how protein structures and genomic sequences are discretized and compressed for large models.

ranked.headline: Computational inference of metabolic regulation from spatial and multi-omic data
ranked.summary: Spatial transcriptomics, pan-cancer multi-omics, and genome-scale models now link metabolic regulation to tissue organization and perturbation.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale mining uncovers novel antimicrobial peptides and bacteriocins
ranked.summary: Catalogues of 60,000 to 280,000 genomes now enable systematic antimicrobial candidate discovery.

ranked.headline: Reduced-alignment methods advance microbial and metagenomic sequence analysis
ranked.summary: Alignment-free and marker-guided methods now match or beat established tools on speed, accuracy and genome recovery in microbial datasets.

ranked.headline: Slide diversity and fused inputs shape H&E histopathology model learning
ranked.summary: H&E foundation model and prostate fusion results show that training slide diversity and input choice govern histopathology learning outcomes.

ranked.headline: Tools for preprocessing and deduplicating omics and sequencing data files
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications address storage cost, file redundancy, and reference library preparation across sequencing and omics workflows.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools link mechanistic models, machine learning, and LLM agents in biology
ranked.summary: Recent open-source tools address model specification, hybrid ML-mechanistic modelling, and natural-language access to SBML kinetic models.

ranked.headline: Learned models and LLM pipelines prioritize compounds and therapeutic assets
ranked.summary: Curated bioassay, trial, and chromatographic data are now paired with learned predictors and explicit ranking or audit layers.

ranked.headline: Reference-free and assembly-quality methods for genome and diversity assessment
ranked.summary: Public genome assemblies and diversity estimators are being evaluated for quality and for reduced dependence on a single curated reference.

ranked.headline: Engineered representations of brain dynamics and topology for neuroimaging analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints engineer brain-imaging representations for patient-specific dynamics and topological connectivity, including MRI/PET data from 1,891 ADNI…

ranked.headline: Intrinsic noise, hysteresis, and Boolean ensembles probe cellular state stability
ranked.summary: Methods now infer state-dependent noise and dynamical distances directly from single-cell and time-series data, linking network structure to stability.

ranked.headline: Computational modeling of flexible CDR loops and immune-relevant protein structures
ranked.summary: Coarse-grained MD and guided diffusion now target flexible antibody CDR loops, extending structure-guided design to conformationally variable regions.

ranked.headline: Causal evaluation and graph learning for gene regulatory and disease networks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints propose causal evaluation metrics and graph-based causal methods for biological networks built from priors and longitudinal clinical data.

ranked.headline: Mesoscale geometry and transport govern condensate aging and protein kinetics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple explicit mesoscale mechanisms to predicted system-level behavior, with geometry or transport as control variables.

ranked.headline: Microstructure-informed models link myofibril and fiber networks to tissue-scale mechanics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple directional microstructure with inverse inference and mechanical prediction in cardiac, skin, and collagen systems.

ranked.headline: Differentiable and recurrent models link neural dynamics to learning and behavior
ranked.summary: Gradient-based training of detailed biophysical and recurrent models now ties circuit mechanisms to voltage, calcium, and conditioning behavior.

ranked.headline: Convergent gene gain and loss in land colonization; a mammalian speciation supergene
ranked.summary: Two published studies and a preprint now apply comparative genome analyses to convergent gene content change and mammalian speciation barriers.

ranked.headline: Machine learning maps plant microproteins, legume expression, and ovule gene regulation
ranked.summary: Deep learning and expression modelling now extend plant annotation to microproteins and cross-species transcription differences.

ranked.headline: Single-cell readouts link gene perturbations, morphology and splicing to function
ranked.summary: Perturbation, imaging and splicing datasets at single-cell scale now support quantitative tests of gene function and immunotherapy response.

ranked.headline: Sequencing and marker design set which environmental lineages enter genomic datasets
ranked.summary: Three 2025 studies test what environmental sampling and sequencing capture across gut, soil, and ocean communities.
